chapters.title: Moses Sees God Face to Face
chapters.synopsis: Caught up into an exceedingly high mountain, Moses sees God face to face, learns he is a son of God, and beholds the world and all its inhabitants. When Satan comes demanding worship, Moses discerns the difference in glory and casts him out in the name of the Only Begotten. God then reveals worlds without number and declares that his work and glory is to bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man.

chapters.title: The Creation Revealed to Moses
chapters.synopsis: The Lord reveals to Moses how, by his Only Begotten, he created the heavens and the earth over six days: light, firmament, land and plants, sun and moon, sea creatures and fowl, and the beasts. On the sixth day God creates man, male and female, in the image of his Only Begotten and gives them dominion. Everything he has made is very good.

chapters.title: Spiritual Creation and the Garden
chapters.synopsis: God rests on the seventh day and explains that all things were created spiritually before they were naturally upon the earth. He forms man from the dust, plants the Garden of Eden, and forbids the tree of knowledge while declaring that Adam may choose for himself. Eve is formed as a help meet for Adam, and the two become one flesh.

chapters.title: Satan Rebels and Adam Falls
chapters.synopsis: God tells Moses how Satan, in the premortal council, sought to destroy the agency of man and take God's honor, and was cast down when the Beloved Son was chosen. Satan then beguiles Eve through the serpent, and Adam and Eve partake of the forbidden fruit. God pronounces the consequences, clothes them in coats of skins, and sends them out of the Garden.

chapters.title: Adam's Offering and Cain's Fall
chapters.synopsis: Outside the garden, Adam and Eve labor, call upon God, and offer sacrifice, and an angel teaches that it is a similitude of the Only Begotten. Filled with the Holy Ghost, they rejoice that their transgression opened the way to redemption. Cain loves Satan more than God, covenants with him as Master Mahan, slays Abel, and secret combinations spread, while the gospel is preached from the beginning.

chapters.title: Enoch Called as a Seer
chapters.synopsis: Adam's righteous posterity through Seth keep a book of remembrance and a genealogy down to Enoch. The Lord calls Enoch, a lad slow of speech, to cry repentance, anoints his eyes so he becomes a seer, and the people tremble at his words. Enoch teaches the plan of salvation the Lord gave Adam, including how Adam was baptized and born of the Spirit.

chapters.title: Enoch and the City of Zion
chapters.synopsis: Enoch sees the Lord face to face and preaches with such power that mountains flee, and his people become Zion, of one heart and one mind with no poor among them. Zion is taken up into heaven, and Enoch watches the God of heaven weep over the wickedness of his children. He sees Noah and the flood, the Son of Man lifted on the cross, and the latter-day gathering when Zion returns to the earth.

chapters.title: Noah Preaches Before the Flood
chapters.synopsis: Methuselah remains on the earth so that the Lord's covenant with Enoch can be fulfilled, and Noah is born to Lamech. The Lord ordains Noah, who preaches faith, repentance, and baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, but the people mock him and giants seek his life. Seeing that the earth is filled with violence, God resolves to destroy all flesh, yet Noah finds grace in his eyes.
